scripts.test: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/cargo/ctx-monorepo/$(basename "$(git rev-parse --git-dir)")} cargo test -q && pnpm -C apps/web test
scripts.test:agent: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/cargo/ctx-monorepo/$(basename "$(git rev-parse --git-dir)")} cargo test -q -p ctx-core -p ctx-providers -p ctx-http -p ctx-mcp -p ctx-lsp && pnpm -C apps/web test:quiet && pnpm -C apps/mobile test:quiet
scripts.desktop:prep: node scripts/desktop_check_versions.cjs && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/cargo/ctx-monorepo/$(basename "$(git rev-parse --git-dir)")} cargo build -p ctx-http -p ctx-mcp && pnpm -C apps/web build && node scripts/desktop_sync_resources.cjs --profile debug
scripts.desktop:prep:release: node scripts/desktop_check_versions.cjs && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/cargo/ctx-monorepo/$(basename "$(git rev-parse --git-dir)")} cargo build -p ctx-http -p ctx-mcp --release && pnpm -C apps/web build && node scripts/desktop_sync_resources.cjs --profile release
scripts.verify:quick: turbo run typecheck --filter=ctx-web --filter=mobile --filter=@ctx/design --filter=@ctx/types --cache-dir=${TURBO_CACHE_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/turbo/ctx-monorepo} --output-logs=errors-only && turbo run test:quiet --filter=ctx-web --filter=mobile --cache-dir=${TURBO_CACHE_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/turbo/ctx-monorepo} --output-logs=errors-only && turbo run rust:fmt rust:clippy rust:test native:check native:test native:test:automation --filter=ctx-monorepo --cache-dir=${TURBO_CACHE_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/turbo/ctx-monorepo} --output-logs=errors-only
